children: NorthWestern Energy affirmed 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance of $3.68 to $3.83 per diluted share at the Barclays Energy-Power Conference.
Executives presented at Barclays conference and furnished the slide deck as Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD.
Affirmed 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance range of $3.68–$3.83, excluding merger-related costs with Black Hills.
Reiterated long-term targets: 4%–6% EPS and rate base growth and $3.2B five-year capital plan.
Plans to fund base capital with cash from operations and debt; equity issuances expected beginning in 2027 for South Dakota generation investment.
